title: Pedir la mano
desc: Asking her family, in a room with everybody in it
setting: Sunday afternoon, doña Elena's front room, and the television is off for the first time in years.

steps.speaker: Doña Elena
steps.en: Right. Here we are. Go ahead.

options.es: Doña Elena, vine a pedirle la mano de Lucía.
options.en: Doña Elena, I came to ask you for Lucía's hand.
options.feedback: The whole sentence, her name in front, no run-up. This is the one moment where the long way round is wrong.

options.es: Vine a hablarles de algo importante.
options.en: I came to talk to you about something important.
options.feedback: Everybody in the room knows what it is. Making them wait is making them work.

options.es: Bueno, ustedes ya saben para qué vine.
options.en: Well, you all know what I came for.
options.feedback: They do. It has to be said out loud by you, and that is the point of the afternoon.

steps.speaker: Doña Elena
steps.es: ¿Y usted con qué la va a mantener?
steps.en: And what are you going to keep her on?

options.es: Con lo que gano en el taller. No es mucho, pero es seguro.
options.en: On what I earn at the workshop. It is not much, but it is steady.
options.feedback: Honest and unpolished. Steady is the word that matters in that room, not the amount.
A phrase with nothing in it. She asked a real question and deserves a number or a name.
True, and it answers a question about you with a fact about her.

steps.speaker: Julio
steps.es: ¿Y si un día se quiere ir para su país?
steps.en: And what if one day you want to go back to your country?

options.es: Si nos vamos, nos vamos los dos, y sería decisión de ella también.
options.en: If we go, we both go, and it would be her decision too.
options.feedback: The fear is that you will take her away. You answered the fear rather than the words.

options.en: I have no plans to leave.
options.feedback: True today. It leaves the fear exactly where it was.
Honest, and in this room it is heard as a maybe. That is the wrong answer to that question.

steps.speaker: Doña Elena
steps.es: Está bien. Pero aquí la boda se hace como Dios manda.
steps.en: All right. But here the wedding is done properly.

options.es: Como usted diga, doña. Yo aprendo lo que haya que aprender.
options.en: As you say, doña. I will learn whatever needs learning.
options.feedback: You gave her the yes and the authority in one sentence, which is what the sentence was asking for.
Agreement without the deference. It is the deference she was checking for.
Perhaps you do. Five minutes after a yes is not when that gets said.
